summary.headline: Astrological Inceptions and Rulership
summary.text: Catalog entries 52–72 for a Greek astrological codex, covering universal, conjunctional, lunar, and solar inceptions; inceptional division and conjecture; beneficial or harmful outcomes; casting of rays; fixed stars, signs, planetary rulership, lunar and stellar afflictions; miscarried embryos, active men, and letters. Authorities and cross-references include Hephaestio, Hermes, and Codex Florentinus 7.
